run_game_hanabi: run a Hanabi game with random player actions using pyhanabi.HanabiGame and pyhanabi.ObservationEncoder
create_hanabi_game: create a HanabiGame instance with configurable parameters like player count and random start player
encode_game_observations: encode Hanabi game observations into canonical tensor format using ObservationEncoder
query_game_state: query Hanabi game state for information tokens, life tokens, fireworks, deck size, and player hands
apply_legal_moves: apply random legal moves to a Hanabi game state until reaching a terminal state
